first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the completion decline and is supported by two inherited findings on activation and early adoption. Verify memory_86 because its downstream connection to sustainable qualified revenue is not explicit. Verify memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest situational alternative, but its long-term margin, retention, and customer-quality effects are unclear despite reported acquisition and revenue lift. Current intent is a standard onboarding experiment rather than discounting broadly.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified evidence shows materially higher completion, 2.1 days faster time-to-value, and a 3% lift in 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitor pressure because its qualified-revenue lift was paired with 12% lower 30-day retention and failure through first renewal. Memory_31 provides additional directional support, though its original source was not re-verified.
